plan.title: SHG Loan Portfolio & Repayment Health
plan.subtitle: Analysis of loan distribution by purpose and repayment status across blocks

panels.title: Total Loan Amount (Rs)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register"

panels.title: Overdue Loan Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "shg_loan_register" WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue'

panels.title: Loan Amount by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Repayment Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status", COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Blocks by Loan Volume
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:

Loan purposes vary, with the bar chart showing the financial weight of each category. The top purpose by loan amount is {{p4}}, suggesting a primary focus on this sector. Other purposes follow in descending order of financial volume.

Geographically, the top blocks by loan volume are listed in the table. The leading block is {{p6}}, which accounts for a significant portion of the total disbursements. This concentration may require targeted monitoring to ensure repayment compliance.
